value: This Reed College summer research project, conducted by a student team, is dedicated to projecting mathematical ideas into the visual realm. It showcases the creation, fabrication methods, and underlying mathematical principles for various topics. Key areas explored include multivariable calculus (such as vector calculus, iterated integrals, and Green's Theorem), applications of 3D printing (e.g., stereographic projection), Milnor fibrations, and the construction and fabrication of bodies of constant width.
